RI-2026-SB3356.title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE CITY OF CRANSTON TO FINANCE THE ACQUISITION, CONSTRUCTION, IMPROVEMENT, RENOVATION, REPAIR AND ALTERATION OF PLAYGROUNDS, ATHLETIC FIELDS AND RELATED EQUIPMENT IN THE CITY BY THE ISSUANCE OF NOT MORE THAN $4,000,000 GENERAL OBLIGATION BONDS AND NOTES THEREFOR
RI-2026-SB3356.summary: Authorizes the city of Cranston to issue not more than $4,000,000 general obligation bonds/temporary notes for the acquisition, construction, improvement, renovation, repair and alteration of playgrounds, athletic fields and related equipment in the city.
RI-2026-SB3356.summarySource: Rhode Island legislature, summary (via Open States)

actions.text: 06/05/2026 Introduced, referred to Senate Housing and Municipal Government

RI-2026-SB3356.aiSummary: Allows the city of Cranston to borrow up to $4 million by issuing general obligation bonds and temporary notes. The money would pay for playgrounds, athletic fields, and related equipment, including buying, building, improving, fixing, and changing them. It became effective without the governor's signature on June 26, 2026.

RI-2026-SB3242.title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE CHARIHO REGIONAL SCHOOL DISTRICT TO FINANCE THE CONSTRUCTION, FURNISHING AND EQUIPPING OF AN ELEMENTARY SCHOOL SERVING THE TOWNS OF CHARLESTOWN, RICHMOND AND HOPKINTON, CONSISTING OF ONE OR MORE BUILDINGS ON A SINGLE CAMPUS, AND IMPROVEMENTS AT THE SWITCH ROAD CAMPUS INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED TO, COSTS OF LAND ACQUISITION, DEMOLITION, DESIGN, HEALTH AND SAFETY PROJECTS, PLAYGROUNDS, LANDSCAPING, PAVING, AND ALL EXPENSES INCIDENTAL THERETO, BY THE ISSUANCE OF NOT MORE THAN $116,000,000 BONDS AND/OR NOTES THEREFOR, SUBJECT TO APPROVAL OF STATE HOUSING AID AT A REIMBURSEMENT RATE OR STATE SHARE RATIO OF NOT LESS THAN 61% AT THE TIME OF ISSUANCE, WHICH RATE OR RATIO MAY INCREASE TO 65% AT PROJECT COMPLETION
RI-2026-SB3242.summary: Authorizes the Chariho Regional School District to finance the construction, furnishing and equipping of an elementary school and to issue not more than $116,000,000 bonds and/or notes.
RI-2026-SB3242.summarySource: Rhode Island legislature, summary (via Open States)

actions.text: 06/10/2026 Placed on the House Consent Calendar (06/10/2026)
05/01/2026 Introduced, referred to Senate Housing and Municipal Government

RI-2026-SB3242.aiSummary: This act lets the Chariho Regional School District borrow up to $116 million to build, furnish, and equip a new elementary school. It also covers land purchase, demolition, design, health and safety work, playgrounds, landscaping, paving, and related costs at the Switch Road campus. The school would serve Charlestown, Richmond, and Hopkinton, and state housing aid would have to be approved at a set share of at least 61% when the money is issued.
